verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible top-to-bottom story order of quote mark, quote, attribution and can, but it has flaws to fix. The attribution is indented about 20px off the quote's left edge and is jammed under the last line, right where the circle starts. The logo also sits on the circle's edge, and the can is small, leaving dead space. B breaks the layout: the quote is squeezed into a narrow right-hand column that wraps every two or three words, and the attribution floats on its own to the left of the quote and reads first, so the reading order is wrong. The logo has shrunk to an illegible speck next to the quote text.
